name: copilotkit
summary: I created the Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, scaffolded the `app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts` runtime handler, wrapped the app in `<CopilotKit>` in `layout.tsx`, and added a `<CopilotSidebar>` in `page.tsx`. TypeScript type-checking (`npx tsc --noEmit`) passed after I corrected the `labels` prop from `title` to `welcomeMessageText` (a deviation from the docs). The build itself timed out before completing, and I could not verify a working copilot endpoint because no `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment. The docs site was also unreachable from the sandbox, so I relied on the GitHub README and the partial quickstart content I was able to fetch.
